name: Moon Rover
tagline: Dust, grit and one hard sun — the lunar surface, not the sky
source: original — a lunar-surface register: regolith greys, hard sun and shadow, drawn dust. No agency, mission, rover or patch artwork is referenced or reproduced; the hardware motif is three primitives (a post, an arm, a box).
use_when: lunar and field-hardware pages, mission-ground products, anything that should feel like dust under one unfiltered sun rather than a view of space
